column4: One single tock of a large old wooden grandfather clock in a small quiet bedroom, a deep hollow wooden knock of its escapement, close, dry, then silence, no music
One single deep strike of an old grandfather clock hour bell in a small wooden room, a resonant slightly out of tune gong with a long fading ring, no music, nothing else
An axe splitting a dry pine log on a chopping block outdoors, one sharp loud crack of the wood bursting in two, the halves knocking down onto grass, close, dry, nothing else
An axe blade biting deep into a dense log and sticking fast, one dull heavy wooden thunk with a short metal ring, close, outdoors, nothing else
A heavy wood axe swung hard downward past the ear, one short low whoosh of air, close, outdoors, no impact, nothing else
A round of firewood set down upright on a wooden chopping block, one solid hollow wooden knock, outdoors, close, nothing else
Two halves of a split firewood log falling onto short dry grass, two soft woody thuds one after the other, outdoors, close, nothing else
An axe wrenched out of a log it was stuck in, a creaking squeak of wood fibres then a soft pop as it comes free, close, outdoors, nothing else
A short friendly two note electronic chime from a 1998 home computer speaker announcing a new chat message, bright then a little lower, clean, nothing else
A soft short rising electronic blip from an old computer speaker, a contact coming online in a chat program, quiet, nothing else
A soft short falling electronic blip from an old computer speaker, a contact going offline in a chat program, quiet, nothing else
Three slow light taps of a fingertip on a window pane from outside at night, heard from inside a quiet small wooden room, a pause between each tap, nothing else
